description: Front porch; installation of side door; enlargement of window to side elevation
decision_conditions: <p>The proposed front porch, by reason of its excessive depth and siting, would result in overshadowing, loss of outlook, and an overbearing visual impact to the detriment of the residential and visual amenities of the occupiers of the neighbouring property, No.7 Marsh Lane. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021 – 2041), and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>

<p>The proposed front porch, by reason of its excessive size, scale, and siting, would give rise to an unsympathetic, incongruous, bulky, obtrusive and contrived form of development which would fail to respect the scale, character and design of the host dwellinghouse and neighbouring properties. The proposal would therefore result in a detrimental impact to the character and appearance of the subject dwellinghouse and the visual amenities of the area, contrary to the high-quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021 – 2041), and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>
